# Calling hours

> Informational, not legal advice. Laws change and courts interpret them; confirm with a lawyer licensed in the jurisdiction before relying on any rule here.

Data: [`data/call-desk/calling-hours.json`](../data/call-desk/calling-hours.json). 32 rules, read on primary sources as of 2026-10-11. Times are the called party's local time and each window ends just before its end time (a 21:00 end means the last allowed minute is 20:59).
